name: The American Presidents: From Washington to Obama
description: Nineteen presidents who shaped the United States, from the founding generation and the Civil War to world wars, the Cold War and the modern era.

checkpoints.name: The founders
checkpoints.note: The generation of Washington, Adams, Jefferson and Madison wins independence, writes the Constitution and learns how a republic should be run, and Jefferson doubles the country with the Louisiana Purchase.

checkpoints.name: A nation divided
checkpoints.note: Andrew Jackson widens the vote, Lincoln holds the Union together through civil war and ends slavery, and Grant presides over the early years of Reconstruction.

checkpoints.name: Rise to world power
checkpoints.note: Theodore Roosevelt, Wilson and Franklin Roosevelt lead a country that grows into an industrial giant, fights two world wars, and meets the Great Depression with the New Deal.

checkpoints.name: The Cold War presidents
checkpoints.note: Truman, Eisenhower, Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon, Carter and Reagan manage rivalry with the Soviet Union, civil rights at home and the war in Vietnam, and Nixon resigns over Watergate in 1974.

checkpoints.name: The modern era
checkpoints.note: Clinton and Obama lead in an age of economic expansion, new technology, the shock of the September 11 attacks, the Iraq War, financial crisis and changing politics at home and abroad.
